_comment: Cities and prefectures in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region (XUAR). The UFLPA creates a rebuttable presumption that goods sourced from XUAR-resident parties were made with forced labor. Supplier addresses matching any of these names should trigger broker review for supply-chain documentation per CBP guidance UFLPA-2022-001.
_source: CBP UFLPA Operational Guidance + DHS Forced Labor Enforcement Task Force public guidance

labor_transfer_destinations._comment: Cities outside XUAR that have hosted documented Uyghur labor-transfer programs. Per DHS guidance, the presumption can apply to entities at these locations when the goods involved a labor transfer.

scrutinized_sectors._comment: Sectors named in UFLPA enforcement priority list. Imports of these goods from anywhere in China face heightened CBP scrutiny per CBP UFLPA Operational Guidance.
